correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs every strict LDC requirement. Twin signatures force at most one excluded vertex per false/true twin class. A coalition graph with four or more vertices has a disjoint edge pair unless it is a star; three star partners force an LD centre, with the sole star-graph exception resolved by its at most two repair vertices. Disjoint LD pairs force all parts of size at most two, at most two universals, and exclude a fifth block. Constructions attain 3 or 4. Independent direct exhaustive partition enumeration passed 94 graph profiles of order 3-10. Finite tests corroborate but do not replace infinite proof.

value.rationale: The new 2026 invariant receives an exact all-parameter classification on natural connected complete multipartite graphs. The structural boundary between four and three is sharp, with arbitrarily large four-case graphs K_{2,...,2} and three-case graphs K_{3,2,...,2}; the uniform constant four sharply improves generic size-dependent bounds.
